chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him), who said:
During the time of God’s Messenger (peace be upon him and his family), we did not recognize the hypocrites except by their animosity towards Ali and his progeny, peace be upon them.
ai.seo_question: How did the companions recognize hypocrites during the Prophet's time?
ai.summary: Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.) identifies hatred towards the Ahl al-Bayt as the definitive mark of hypocrisy during the Prophet's era, a concept foundational to Shia exegesis of the Verse of Purification and the Verse of Mawaddah. This narration underscores that love for the Prophet's progeny is not merely a devotional act but a criterion for authentic faith, distinguishing the sincere from the insincere in the early Muslim community.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-306 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Al-Husayn ibn Ali (a.s.), “
During the time of God’s Prophet (S) we could not recognize the hypocrites except by their animosity towards Ali (a.s.) and his progeny.”
